jobs.title: Lead, Strategy Manager, Corporate
jobs.description:
Who We Are Looking For:
The Corporate Strategy Manager will support Nike's Senior Leadership Team in the development of growth strategies that drive high-level priorities across key business units, markets, and Nike, Inc., brands.
This role will:
·       Direct & execute analysis and due diligence for new growth opportunities, leading to actionable recommendations
·       Lead strategic project workstreams leveraging sound hypotheses and rigorous frameworks, pushing beyond analytics & research to insight
·       Catalyze the execution of actionable plans with senior leaders and their functional teams
·       Align and lead senior teams through ambiguity in a complex organizational matrix, providing project management support to cross-functional teams, including coordinating process milestones and deliverables
·       Collaborate with various cross-functional teams throughout the business to prepare business reviews, scorecards, and materials for strategic workshops

What You Will Work On:
The role will support Nike's Senior Leadership Team, partnering heavily with Finance, Insights & Analytics, Corporate Development & other cross-functional Strategy teams.

What You Bring:
·       Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Applied Science or related field. Will accept any suitable combination of education, experience and training
·       Masters degree preferred.
·       5+ years of proven experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, investment banking, corporate finance, corporate development, or business development.
·       Experience in leading sophisticated strategic projects and proven success in leading a methodical process of analyzing problems, gathering information, generating options, then proposing and acting on a course of action
·       Consistent track record of pulling together diverse individuals with different goals and facilitating productive discussions
·       Proficiency in business communication tools and verbal/written storytelling + communication to promote conceptual understanding and mobilize change through storytelling
·       Bias towards action and comfortable working in ambiguity, and ability to work through complexity & adversity
·       Superior interpersonal and relationship building skills
·       A curious mind and growth-orientation
·       Business development, quantitative & qualitative acumen
·       Strategic planning
·       Project management in a cross-functional, global matrix environment
·       Data analysis and financial modeling
·       Market analysis

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Manager
jobs.description:
Location-Wolf Creek Distribution Center-Atlanta, GA
Shift-Monday-Friday-8AM-5PM

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The candidate for this role needs to be able to coach and influence others, including those that do not directly report to them, by clearly communicating vision and purpose to drive a deep understanding of Nike Continuous Improvement. This role will require multi-faceted support of Distribution Operations through the continuous improvement journey, from workshop facilitation to daily metrics gathering to job aid creation, all toward the goal of helping our Nike Athletes reach their peak performance.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

The Continuous Improvement Manager will establish consistent methods, tools, and ways of working; build operational rigor and problem-solving capabilities; and partner with Nike and 3PL leaders to improve service, cost efficiency, and long-term performance.
This role serves as a key partner to Distribution Operations, coaching Athletes on the floor toward peak performance as well as planning future improvements to Distribution Center processes, systems, & material handling equipment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Support the development of the continuous improvement strategy for logistics, cultivate a culture of continuous improvement, and coach functional business partners on our operating system.
- Serve as a subject matter expert and coach for continuous improvement principles, tools, and techniques to drive a culture of operational excellence within the distribution center team.
- Identify improvement areas and set priorities by offering data-driven analyses on distribution center performance and processes.
- Utilize root cause analysis and lean process design principles to identify and eliminate waste and non-value-added activities within the distribution.
- Cross functional collaboration across the NASC network to benchmark, teach others, and learn from other Nike sites.
- Collaborate with stakeholders at various levels to drive alignment, foster collaboration, and ensure integrated execution of initiatives.
- Establish and maintain standards based on industry best practices to drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
- Document, standardize, and enhance CI tools and processes to ensure consistent application and effectiveness across the supply chain.
- Internally assess prioritized work, align teams around measurable KPIs, and clearly scope initiatives the Nike CI team will deploy to support.
- Independently assess progress, hold teams accountable to agreed up measurable KPIs, and professionally escalate where help is needed.
- Validate initiatives post-implementation and build out communication feedback loop to senior leadership.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

Nike’s new distribution facility in Wolf Creek, GA requires dedicated continuous improvement leadership to translate strategy into execution. This role is part of our North America Operations function focused on driving benefits of scale and promoting a common strategic approach.  This role will partner with Nike operations leadership, 3PL partners, and cross-functional teams to establish the methods by which daily performance is measured, problems are identified, and solutions are implemented to ensure operational targets are met.

The Continuous Improvement (CI) team serves the operations teams across the North America Supply Chain with a standard, market-driven Operating System focused on three pillars.

Design: Creation of standard logistics templates on the intersection of processes and people, the infrastructure and automation that they function within, and the tech products they work with.

Run & Improve the Business: Through coaching and development, cultivate a culture of continuous improvement to empower Logistics teams to enact problem solving at the lowest possible level. Sustained through Operating Systems (OS) Thinking: Adopted and applied by our Logistics Leaders from strategy deployment to practical problem solving.

WHAT YOU BRING
- Bachelor’s Degree in related field or equivalent experience / education.
- 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Program Management, and/or Lean/Agile
- Proficiency of Lean and continuous improvement principles, with knowledge of the Toyota Production System as a plus.
- Travel can range from minimal up to 20% dependent on work required and Distribution Center(s) supported.

jobs.title: Manager, Finance Supply Chain, EMEA
jobs.description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

In this role you will predominantly work closely with the logistics team and the Nike Direct teams. However, you will also have regular touchpoints with other functions, mainly in business planning and accounting.  You will report directly into the Finance Director Supply Chain EMEA. Your main stakeholders will be ELC, EHQ and global finance as well as business partners within distribution, transportation and other supporting functions.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for an experienced finance individual to support Nike’s supply chain as supply chain finance manager. The ability to run a complex portfolio, influence decision making and lead change will be key to success in this role, as well as displaying high levels of business partnering skills with senior leaders. The ideal candidate should possess leadership ability, strategic thinking, maturity, and finance acumen. While knowledge in supply chain is strongly preferred, it’s not a requirement. We are looking for a highly motivated individual to join in this dynamic position with high exposure to EMEA senior leaders.

Show us your game plan via your cv:

- A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, giving you the foundation to turn numbers into business impact.
- 5+ years of experience in Financial Planning or Finance Strategy, with a track record of influencing key business decisions.
- The confidence and credibility to challenge, influence, and advise senior leaders, helping shape the future of the business.
- A unique ability to combine people leadership with a hands-on approach . You roll up your sleeves, dive into complex analyses, build scenarios, and transform financial insights into action.
- Strong financial and analytical capabilities , with the curiosity to uncover opportunities and the courage to challenge the status quo.
- A collaborative mindset that allows you to connect the dots across teams, functions, and markets in a dynamic global organization.
- Exceptional communication and storytelling skills , enabling you to simplify complexity and inspire action at every level of the business.
- Experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations Finance is a plus.

WHO YOU ARE
- You thrive at the intersection of strategy and execution.
- You see beyond the numbers and understand the story they tell.
- You are energized by solving complex business challenges and influencing decisions that drive growth.
- You lead from the front, balancing people leadership with deep financial expertise.
- You build trust, create alignment, and help teams move faster and smarter toward their goals.

IMPORTANT AND NON-NEGOTIABLE NOTE:

1. No relocation package/deal : candidates must currently reside in Belgium to be considered for this position. Applications from outside Belgium will not be accepted.
2. Hybrid working : 2 days/week home office, 3 days/week at the office

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

You will help drive the supply chain cost to serve strategy for EMEA by bridging the gap between logistics and finance. You will advise and influence supply chain senior leadership on optimal fulfilment strategies and actively seek opportunities to improve. As part of this, you will play a crucial role in determining and rolling out our long-term network strategy in a multi-node environment and ensure deep understanding of the holistic impact of network related decisions. You will lead a limited team of (senior)analysts. Additionally, you will improve cost allocation on channel and account level to gain better understanding of channel/account profitability.

In this role you will also partner closely with Nike Direct teams (Retail and .com) to ensure the necessary insights are available to support month-end close and forecast cycles as well as long term strategic decision making.

jobs.title: Lead, Strategy Manager, NA
jobs.description:
Job Description

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for Lead, Strategy Manager to help shape the future of Nike Inc. These roles partner closely with the executive, functional, and leadership teams to identify strategic priorities, define long-term growth opportunities, and translate insights into actions that drive athlete*, consumer, marketplace, and business impact. The ideal candidate is an exceptional strategic thinker, problem solver, and collaborator who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by helping leaders make critical decisions. This person will bring a balance of analytical rigor, business acumen, and communication excellence to influence the future direction of one of Nike's most important and visible dimensions. This role will:
- Direct & execute analysis and due diligence for new growth opportunities, leading to actionable recommendations

- Lead strategic project workstreams leveraging sound hypotheses and rigorous frameworks, pushing beyond analytics & research to insight

- Catalyze the execution of actionable plans with senior leaders and their functional teams

- Align and lead senior teams through ambiguity in a complex organizational matrix, providing project management support to cross-functional teams, including coordinating process milestones and deliverables

- Collaborate with various cross-functional teams throughout the business to prepare business reviews, scorecards, and materials for strategic workshops

What You Will Work On

As a Lead, Strategy Manager, you will support Nike's Senior Leadership Team, partnering heavily with Finance, Insights & Analytics, Corporate Development & other cross-functional Strategy teams, help lead the strategic planning process, develop strategic recommendations, and serve as a trusted thought partner to senior leaders on the most important opportunities and challenges facing the business. You will independently lead cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives through three primary bodies of work:

- Building Integrated Growth Plans : Drive integrated actions that help Nike Inc. win with athletes* and consumers while delivering sustainable growth. Partner with leaders to answer complex strategic questions, align and mobilize cross-functional teams around shared priorities, and translate long-term strategies into actionable plans that accelerate business and organizational impact.

- Developing Future Strategies : Identify and shape Nike Inc.’s next growth opportunities beyond the core business. Through long-range planning and strategic exploration, develop frameworks, insights, and recommendations that help leaders evaluate emerging trends, unlock new growth vectors, and make informed choices about where Nike should invest for the future.

- Assessing Impact : Measure progress against strategic priorities and help leaders focus resources on the highest-impact opportunities. Diagnose performance, identify key learnings, develop KPIs, and communicate clear recommendations that strengthen decision-making, improve execution, and drive continuous improvement over time.

What You Bring to Nike

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Applied Science or related field. Will accept any suitable combination of education, experience and training

- Masters degree preferred

- 5+ years of experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, investment banking, corporate finance, business operations, business development, corporate development, or a related field

- Experience in leading sophisticated strategic projects and proven success in leading a methodical process of analyzing problems, gathering information, generating options, then proposing and acting on a course of action

- Proven success influencing cross-functional teams and stakeholders without direct authority

- Consistent track record of pulling together diverse individuals with different goals and facilitating productive discussions

- Strong understanding of growth strategy, business performance, and value creation within consumer-facing industries

- Experience in apparel, footwear, retail, consumer products, sports, or adjacent industries preferred

- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to create structure from ambiguity and synthesize large amounts of information into actionable insights

- Outstanding communication and written / verbal storytelling capabilities, with the ability to simplify complexity and influence executive audiences

- Bias towards action and comfortable working in ambiguity, and ability to work through complexity and adversity

- Advanced presentation and business communication skills, including proficiency with Keynote and other presentation tools

- Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational pragmatism and execution focus

- Strong interpersonal skills with a track record of building trust and credibility across diverse teams and leadership levels

- Curiosity, demonstrated learning agility, and a growth mindset

- Passion for sport, athletes, consumers, and products a plus

- Business development, quantitative & qualitative acumen

- Strategic planning

- Project management in a cross-functional, global matrix environment

- Data/market analysis and financial modeling

If you discover, as you navigate our application process, that you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please complete the Candidate Accommodation Request Form .

jobs.title: NIKE, Inc. Strategic Planning Graduate Internship
jobs.description:
Every successful team at Nike needs a sharp game plan. Strategy teams help shape and drive the company’s growth agenda by leading enterprise business planning, aligning leadership around the most critical opportunities, and spearheading transformational work across Nike’s diverse businesses and geographies. Embedded across the company, you’ll act as a trusted thought partner to senior leaders—exploring complex business questions, analyzing consumer, competitive, and market insights, building financial models, and translating ideas into action. Known for developing high‑impact talent, the Strategy organization has a strong legacy of alumni who go on to lead across Nike’s functions and businesses. With bold thinking and the DNA to catalyze action, you’ll help chart Nike’s path forward.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:
You’ll be embedded within one of Nike’s Strategy teams and work closely with experienced strategists, cross‑functional partners, and senior leaders across the company. You’ll own and deliver a high‑impact project aligned to your team’s priorities. Through hands‑on project work and functional programming, you’ll gain broad exposure across the Strategy function, build a deep understanding of Nike’s business, and form relationships with leaders shaping the company’s long‑term growth.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Nike Strategy is looking for MBA and Master’s talent interested in Corporate Strategy. You may be aligned to opportunities across several Strategy teams, including:
- Brand (Nike, Jordan & Sport Dimensions)
- Product (Design, Creation & Innovation)
- Geo & Marketplace
- Corporate Strategy

As a Strategy Intern, you’ll join teams leading Nike into the future by delivering integrated sets of choices and actions. Your work will be grounded in objective, insight‑driven answers to the most critical strategic questions—helping Nike serve athletes* with competitive separation and long‑term, profitable growth.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:
In the NIKE, Inc. Summer Internship Program, you’ll contribute to high‑priority, real business initiatives aligned to the NIKE, Inc. strategic roadmap.

With the guidance of senior leaders and experienced managers, you’ll take ownership of a project that’s been scoped to drive impact.  These projects are designed to challenge your critical thinking, further develop your skills and foster effective collaboration while contributing directly to your team’s goals.

As a Strategy Intern, you’ll partner to develop elements of NIKE, Inc.’s global long-term growth strategy. You’ll manage one or more cross-functional projects in support of management to help identify and evaluate critical strategic priorities and/or problems, and to catalyze action against these priorities through long-range business planning and performance management.

Project examples may include:
- How must our retail strategy be evolved to better serve Global Football athletes in North America?
- What opportunities could unlock the next wave of Nike Fitness growth?
- How should our approach to Jordan athlete marketing be evolved to better serve the youth of tomorrow?

This is a 10-week paid internship opportunity with relocation assistance. Curious to know what it’s like to be part of a world-class Internship Program? Check out our recap video from last summer: Nike Internship Program Recap Video

WHAT YOU BRING:

Qualifications:
- Enrolled in an MBA program or Master’s program with an expected graduation date of Winter 2027 or Spring 2028
- 3-5 years work experience strongly preferred
- Experience in corporate strategy, strategy consulting, business development, corporate development, investment banking, finance, digital/e-commerce, retail or general apparel brands, or other experience developing the skills defined below
- A resume and cover letter are both required. Please upload and submit as a single combined PDF file.

Skills:
- Demonstrated problem structuring and strategic problem-solving skills with experience leading multiple simultaneous projects.
- Ability to navigate and thrive in ambiguity and influence across a cross-functional, matrixed environment.
- Experience presenting to and influencing senior leadership with excellent written and oral communication skills.
- Outstanding interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional environment with a positive, can-do attitude.
- Ability to complete quantitative and qualitative analyses, and distill results into actionable insights

Mynext: Be Empowered to Grow within Nike and Create the Future

This internship – as well as full-time positions – are located in-person at the NIKE, Inc. Philip H. Knight Campus in Beaverton, OR. Check out this video to learn more about life on campus:  Nike PHK Campus Video .

jobs.title: Principal, Strategy, Energy
jobs.description:

We are looking for a Principal strategist who will work with executive leadership to develop and implement Nike Energy’s global long-term strategy, identify and evaluate critical strategic priorities, and catalyze action against these priorities through business planning processes. Nike Energy is the team that sets the pace for partnerships, collaborations, and new opportunities for Nike – this may include but is not limited to art, fashion, luxury, streetwear, innovation, gaming & fandom, and new frontiers.

Information about benefits can be found here .

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We’re looking for a Jordan Brand Marketing Manager based out of Los Angeles that will support the strategic direction and execution in partnership with North America for Critical Sport and commercial moments. This position will lead our cohort marketing offense for prioritized consumer segments, creating and executing strategies that drive meaningful, daily relationships with Jordan Brand consumers.

The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, a proven track record developing and executing cohort-based, multi-channel marketing plans, and a passion for obsessing the consumer – who they are, how they behave, what their needs are, and how we, as Jordan, can best serve them!

- BA/BS Degree, will accept any suitable combination of education and experience, and training
- 5+ years of work experience in digital/online marketing or related field
- Expert understanding of digital marketing strategy and tactics across key channels including digital apps, email, .com experiences, paid media and social
- Proven track record leading and executing cohort-based, multi-channel marketing strategies, ideally for parent/teen targets
- Outstanding leadership skills to influence functional teams and large cross-functional projects
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentations
- Strong analytical skills and comfort leveraging art and science to inform plans and decision making
- Strong understanding of digital analytics best practices and proven capability to use data to drive business decisions
- Experience working in Agile processes, a plus

Preferred:
- Experience leading brand campaigns targeting the performance consumer.
- Experience working in sport / basketball category.
- Experience working in highly matrixed, complex organizations.

jobs.title: Senior Auditor, Global Audit and Risk Management
jobs.description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
You’ll join Nike’s GARM (Global Audit and Risk Management) team, a collaborative group of risk professionals dedicated to protecting Nike’s value and brand. The Senior Auditor will report directly to the GARM Director and support work that is highly visible to our NIKE, Inc. executive management and the Audit and Finance Committee of the Board of Directors.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Our Global Audit Risk Management (GARM) team partners with management across the enterprise to enhance and protect NIKE’s value and brand through world-class risk management capabilities, such as internal audit and risk advisory services.

We’re seeking an experienced auditor who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. This individual brings strong audit expertise, sharp project management skills, and the ability to "connect the dots" across complex business landscapes. - Enjoy ambiguity and can make progress without perfect information.

- Take an analytical, evidence-based approach to problem solving.

- Apply thoughtful judgment when navigating nuanced people or business matters.

- Stay curious and ask proactive questions before reaching conclusions.

- Build trust by respectfully offering new perspectives and constructive guidance with stakeholders while maintaining strong partnerships.

- Bring energy and optimism, especially during periods of change.

- Balance the needs of employees, leaders, and the broader organization.

- Communicate complex concepts in simple, actionable language.

- Develop thoughtful recommendations on complex compensation matters.

- Apply compensation programs consistently while accounting for business context.

jobs.title: Manager, Procurement, Sourcing
jobs.description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
This role joins Global Procurement and reports to the Global Sourcing Director. They lead two sourcing managers and oversee the sourcing Managed Service Provider (MSP) supporting North America and Asia Pacific Latin America, partnering with Procurement category leaders, Operations, Finance, Legal, Risk, business stakeholders, and global sourcing teams.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Nike is looking for a decisive, people-first sourcing leader who can turn global strategy into strong execution. This person brings strategic and tactical sourcing expertise, category management knowledge, contracting experience, and a track record of managing teams and service providers. They know how to lead complex sourcing events, evaluate suppliers, negotiate commercial terms, and keep work moving across multiple spend categories and geographies. They combine industry insight with disciplined execution, using performance measures to identify risk, resolve issues, and improve the customer experience. The ideal candidate builds trust quickly, communicates with clarity, and challenges plans when local realities demand a different approach. They foster effective teamwork, develop others, embrace change, and create accountability without losing sight of the bigger picture.

The candidate will bring:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, or related field.
- Minimum of 5 years of directly relevant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, contracting, or procurement operations.
- Experience leading and developing people, including sourcing professionals responsible for day-to-day event execution.
- Experience managing a Managed Service Provider, including performance against service-level agreements, issue resolution, risk management, and continuous improvement.
- Demonstrated ability to lead requests for proposal, supplier evaluation and award processes, commercial negotiations, and contract execution across multiple areas of spend.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
You will lead sourcing execution across North America and Asia Pacific Latin America, turning global category strategies into practical local action. You will guide the internal sourcing team, hold the Managed Service Provider accountable for performance, and create a clear path from sourcing intake through contracting and closure.

- Lead best-in-class sourcing execution across North America and Asia Pacific Latin America, balancing priorities and workload across multiple procurement categories.
- Manage and develop two sourcing managers responsible for executing sourcing activities, while overseeing the scope and performance of the Managed Service Provider.
- Own the geography stakeholder experience from sourcing intake through event completion, supplier selection, contracting, and closure.
- Build strong relationships with geography-based Procurement Category Directors, Senior Managers, Principals, Leads, and business stakeholders to align priorities and resolve issues.
- Translate global category strategies into operational sourcing plans, bringing forward local market insights, requirements, risks, and opportunities.
- Monitor Managed Service Provider performance against service-level agreements, address delivery gaps, and coordinate issue resolution across Nike teams.
- Use industry benchmarking, sourcing expertise, and performance insights to strengthen compliance, process excellence, change adoption, and sourcing outcomes.

jobs.title: Manager, Supply Chain and Inventory Accounting Japan
jobs.description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
This role reports directly to the Director, Controller – Japan and leads the Senior Accountant – Supply Chain and Inventory Accounting. The Manager partners closely with the Japan Finance team and collaborates across Nike Japan, including Logistics and Nike Planning (Inventory Operations), to strengthen financial alignment, support informed decision-making, and drive operational excellence.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Nike is looking for a Manager, Supply Chain and Inventory Accounting to join the Japan Supply Chain and Inventory Accounting team. The ideal candidate brings strong accounting expertise, sound judgment, and a collaborative leadership approach. This role is responsible for ensuring complete, accurate, and timely financial reporting while maintaining a robust and effective internal control environment over financial reporting.
- Minimum of 5-6 years of progressive experience in public accounting and/or multinational organizations, preferably with experience in Supply Chain and Inventory Accounting under United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP)
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, strongly preferred with Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or equivalent professional qualification
- Ability to translate business requirements into practical solutions while identifying and addressing financial risks and controls across end-to-end processes
- Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and consistently deliver high-quality results
- A forward-thinking, process-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and transformation
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Japanese, with the ability to communicate effectively with local and global stakeholders

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
You will lead timely and accurate month-end close activities while continuously improving the efficiency and effectiveness of Supply Chain and Inventory Accounting and financial reporting processes. You will partner with managed service providers supporting accounting operations across Asia Pacific Latin America (APLA), strengthen key controls, and help enable informed business decisions.
- Ensure key financial assertions are achieved for Supply Chain and Inventory Accounting by building and maintaining a robust control framework across transaction streams. You will oversee internal controls over financial reporting, judgmental reserves, supply chain-related investments, and product cost accounting treatments.
- Evaluate evolving business models, including third-party royalties and complementary products, and determine the appropriate accounting treatment for supply chain-related transactions.
- Build trusted, collaborative relationships across teams, functions, and organizational levels while applying deep expertise in US GAAP, particularly in Supply Chain and Inventory Accounting.
- Partner closely with the Senior Accountant and managed service provider to enhance the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of the month-end close process.
- Collaborate with the APLA Supply Chain and Inventory Accounting team to advance global controlling initiatives, including standardization, automation, and centralization.

jobs.title: Principal, Strategy EMEA
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced, consumer-centric strategist who challenges conventional thinking, brings clarity to ambiguity and translates strategy into focused action. The Principal, EMEA Strategy will be a senior individual contributor within the EMEA Strategy team, helping shape and activate the future of Nike's integrated marketplace across Nike Direct and wholesale channels.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
You will report to the Director, Strategy EMEA, responsible for Marketplace, and work closely with the EMEA Strategy team and EMEA Marketplace leadership. Your primary business partners will be leaders across Nike Direct and Nike Sales with close connection to Global Strategy.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
The successful candidate will bring marketplace experience across owned and wholesale channels, alongside a strong track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional strategy work from problem definition through recommendation and activation. They will combine rigorous problem solving with strong commercial judgment, stakeholder influence and the ability to connect enterprise direction with EMEA business realities.

What you bring:
- Solid experience in top-tier strategy consulting, commercial leadership and/or strategy roles within a complex consumer-led business; MBA or equivalent experience preferred.
- Demonstrated marketplace experience across owned and wholesale channels, with an understanding of how consumer, brand and commercial choices come together across an integrated marketplace.
- Proven ability to independently lead complex strategic projects and planning processes from framing through recommendation and activation.
- Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous questions and apply rigorous quantitative and qualitative analysis.
- Strong business judgment and the ability to connect consumer, brand, marketplace, commercial and financial considerations.
- Executive presence and proven influencing and relationship-management skills, with the ability to operate as a credible peer to senior business leaders and drive alignment without formal authority.
- Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with experience developing clear, executive-ready recommendations.
- Ability to operate with a high degree of independence while maintaining clear upward communication and surfacing key risks and choices.
- Consumer-centric and entrepreneurial mindset, with a strong bias toward impact and action, and a collaborative, challenging and caring team orientation.

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
Reporting to the Director, Strategy EMEA, responsible for Marketplace, you will lead priority strategic workstreams focused on shaping the future of the EMEA marketplace across Nike Direct and wholesale channels. You will also contribute to the annual strategic planning process, translating enterprise and EMEA priorities into clear choices, implications and plans.
- Lead end-to-end strategic projects across marketplace growth and broader business priorities, owning the problem solving, workplan and cross-functional engagement from framing through recommendation and activation.
- Develop fact-based perspectives, scenarios and executive-ready recommendations that support strategic planning and leadership decision-making, combining consumer, competitive, commercial and financial analysis.
- Partner with business leaders and critical functions as a trusted thought partner, constructively challenging assumptions, building alignment and translating strategy into clear priorities and executable plans.
- Contribute to the quality, capability and development of the broader EMEA and Global Strategy community through coaching, collaboration and best-practice sharing.

Application deadline: October 19, 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Global Finance - Converse
jobs.description:
The annual base salary for this position ranges from $83,800.00 in our lowest geographic market to $165,400.00 in our highest geographic market. Actual salary will vary based on a candidate's location, qualifications, skills and experience.
Information about benefits can be found here .

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
The Senior Financial Analyst, Global Finance is a valuable contributor on our dynamic Global Finance team helping to deliver financial insights & reports to the CFO & Converse Leadership team. In this role you will partner closely with functional and geo leaders across the world to support creation and execution of Converse strategies. You will be part of Global Finance team responsible for bringing together insightful, financially disciplined analysis to support the Converse transformation agenda.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
To succeed in the role, you must be a self-starter who can work with limited oversight. You must possess excellent analytical skills, attention to detail paired with the ability to see the bigger picture, a strong work ethic and a desire to continuously learn and help evolve the department and how we service our internal stakeholders. The candidate needs to have extensive experience in financial modeling and requires expert Excel skills, in addition to the following qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, strategic planning, economics or related field. Will accept any suitable combination of education, experience and training

- Minimum 3 years of professional experience in a business-related field and/or budgeting at a Fortune 500 company.

- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills while being independent and resourceful

- Strong understanding of P&L structure, accounting fundamentals, and month-end close mechanics

- High attention to detail and accuracy with tight deadlines

- Ability to thrive in a changing environment with agility, curiosity, and passion to create extraordinary value

- Strong ability to communicate complex and/or challenging topics and concepts

- Strong ability to pivot between financial analysis and business partnership activities

- Client service attitude and ability to exercise high degree of professionalism

- Ability to manage multiple and changing processes and priorities

- Process and detail-oriented with the ability to think holistically and strategically

- Innate desire to continuously explore, learn, and exercise intellectual curiosity

- Ability to create/deliver influential presentations

- Advanced proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint

- SAP, BI, Tableau experience preferred

- Experience in retail or manufacturing industry preferred

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
As Senior Financial Analyst, Global Finance you’ll be responsible for delivering actionable financial insights to move the Converse business forward. You will have direct responsibility for developing and maintaining financial models and delivering financial analysis to support leadership decision making. A successful candidate will bring a highly analytical, solution oriented, and entrepreneurial mindset to the role to drive the following:
- Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual P&L consolidation reporting

- Ensure accuracy of financial data as well as maintain and enhance reporting systems.

- Prepare and distribute timely and insightful financial analysis to measure progress against strategic plan, work with partners to ensure accountability, and support marketplace decisions.

- Actively interprets and reviews financial results with senior leaders, including trends/issues and opportunities, to drive actionable responses.

- Responsible for orchestrating and executing monthly forecasting and reporting process, understanding and advising the appropriate levers to pull across geographies and P&L dimensions.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to clearly understand risks and opportunities to financial forecasts and to advise strategies to help the business achieve financial objectives through financial modeling and scenario analysis.

- Continuously streamline processes and tools in respect to business planning, aiming to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality

Please note, we are looking to fill four positions.
